items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: the piano player and I, [Harris Wanigan,] we went around to this little hamburger joint

ctx.x: The twenties. Gillis -- yes, it seems to me I read about that. What happened there any way?

Well, any way they had a little hamburger joint right around the stand, right around the corner there, and the piano player and I, [Harris Wanigan,] we went around to this little hamburger joint. We started around there, as soon as we got into the lobby this explosion went off, man. Well, what happened, it was kind of misty rain that day -- that night, I mean, and I thought I was running up fast, you know, and I fell man, on the street with all that water, you know. You understand what I mean. Somebody said, I…
You had a long stay at the Gillis. Well, of course you didn't go back to the Gillis Theatre.
